title: phpBB Variables
description: Configuration variables for deploying and serving the phpBB forum web application.

PHPBB_LISTEN.description: HTTP bind address:port or UNIX socket endpoint configured for phpBB.

PHPBB_PHP_FPM_LISTEN.description: PHP-FPM FastCGI upstream socket or host:port endpoint executing phpBB scripts.

PHPBB_SERVER_NAME.description: Virtual host domain or hostname serving the phpBB forum.

PHPBB_WEBSERVER.description: Frontend web server component fronting phpBB (e.g., nginx, caddy, httpd).

PHPBB_VERSION.description: Target phpBB release version or alias (e.g., latest) to install.

PHPBB_DB_PASS.description: Database password authenticating the phpBB database account.

PHPBB_DB_TYPE.description: Database driver backend for phpBB (e.g., postgres, mysql, mariadb, sqlite3).

PHPBB_WWWROOT.description: Filesystem document root directory containing the unpacked phpBB installation.

PHPBB_DB_NAME.description: Database name storing phpBB forum topics, users, and configuration.

PHPBB_DB_USER.description: Database username used by phpBB to connect to its database.
